messages:
alex: Heads up — seeing sustained 5xx spike and long queues on infer nodes in eu-west for the last ~3m. CPU fine but network errors to the NAT/egress pool. tagging @oncall.
chris: I'm seeing backend connection resets from the GLB health checks to ~30% of eu-west nodes. probs at the VPC NAT layer, not the runtime.
maya: Any impact on customer traffic? metrics?
alex: Yes, latency + error budget burning. ~15% of requests failing with 502/504. traffic drop to eu-west is auto-kicking but we still get retries that amplify load.
sam: Can we shift weights off eu-west temporarily? we should avoid full region cut if we can gracefully shift.
chris: Agreed. I'll prepare a weighted reroute. Dry-run first.
chris: ```bash
# dry-run
redwoodctl routing set-weights --global \ 
  eu-west=10 us-west=70 ap-south=20 --dry-run
```
maya: +1 to gradual. Also enable the prefix cache on us-west to absorb burst if needed.
alex: @opsbot can you pause any automated provisioning actions that might bounce eu-west nodes while we investigate? we don't want scaling loops.
opsbot: Action queued: suspend-autoscale(eu-west) by request of alex. ETA immediate. :white_check_mark:
chris: Running real update now — will push eu-west=0 if we see any sign of instability after 30s.
chris: ```bash
redwoodctl routing set-weights --global eu-west=0 us-west=80 ap-south=20 --commit
```
deploy-bot: Global routing policy updated by chris: eu-west=0, us-west=80, ap-south=20. Rollout: immediate.
alex: Monitoring graphs — 5xx count dropped ~60% in the last 45s. p95 latency on us-west up ~12% but within SLO.
maya: Can we enable model fallback to smaller quantized variant in ap-south as buffer if token cost spikes? that would help CPU and GPU memory pressure.
sam: That would increase variance in outputs; we should gate it to non-enterprise tenants. I'll flip a route-level policy.
sam: ```json
{"route_policy":"fallback-quant","scope":"non-enterprise","state":"on"}
```
chris: ops-ticket created: INF-5824 — NAT gateway provider reported packet drops in eu-west. assigned to network team.
alex: Good. Let's keep eu-west zeroed until network team confirms stable and we run a canary heal test. Also note cost bump — us-west bursted additional instances. I'll put a note in #finance later.
maya: I'll run traffic replay from archived traces to validate correctness post-reroute and to sanity check token consumption.
chris: Once network team gives all-clear, we'll do phased ramp: eu-west=5 -> 15 -> baseline. Need monitoring gates at each step.
oncall: Acknowledged. Oncall will stay on until INF-5824 resolved. ping me for escalation.
alex: Thanks team. Adding short runbook steps in INF-5824 so support can communicate to customers. :thumbsup:
